t: The Forge Energy Power Tap allows you to extract energy from a $(l:bigreactors/passive)passively cooled$(/l) Reactor. This Power Tap outputs energy using the Forge Energy $(l:bigreactors/powersystem)power system$(/l), meaning it can only be connected to pipes or machines that are compatible with that system.
Forge Energy 能量输出端口允许你从$(l:bigreactors/passive)被动冷却$(/l)反应堆中提取能量。该输出端口使用 Forge Energy $(l:bigreactors/powersystem)供能系统$(/l)输出能量，这意味着它只能连接到兼容该系统的管道或机器。

Only one $(l:bigreactors/powersystem)power system$(/l) can be used for each Reactor, which means only one type of Power Tap can be utilized in a single Reactor build. The Power Tap is available in both $(l:bigreactors/passiveactiveparts)passive and active$(/l) forms.
每个反应堆只能使用一种$(l:bigreactors/powersystem)供能系统$(/l)，这意味着在单个反应堆结构中只能使用一种类型的能量输出端口。能量输出端口同时提供$(l:bigreactors/passiveactiveparts)被动和主动$(/l)两种形式。
